_comment: FICTIONAL fixture. Planted flaws for the 1.4.0 audit checks: evals/check_fixtures.py checks that the audit reports each audit_id (run in CI); eval 14 (Polish) is graded against the fixes. Keep outside any agent's working folder.

defects.defect: A fixed 56 px lab header bar was added with body padding but no scroll-padding-top, so every Contents jump lands its section heading under the bar
defects.fix: Add html { scroll-padding-top: 56px } (or stop fixing the bar)

defects.defect: The abstract was squeezed into a box with max-height: 180px and overflow: hidden (a read-more without the button), so most of it is cut off
defects.fix: Remove the max-height and overflow so the whole abstract shows

defects.defect: Limitations fades in with a scroll-reveal whose script only runs when reduced motion is off, so reduced-motion visitors never see the limitations
defects.fix: Show .reveal content by default and apply the fade only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference, or remove the reveal

defects.defect: A fixed announcement banner at the bottom of the screen covers controls that keyboard focus scrolls to
defects.fix: Add html { scroll-padding-bottom } equal to the banner's height, or make the banner part of the page flow

defects.defect: Carousel dots shrunk to 8 x 8 px with 4 px between them (a tweak to make them look smaller)
defects.fix: Restore the dots' 28 x 44 px hit area (keep a small visible dot inside it)

defects.defect: An empty 16:9 video wrapper left after the YouTube iframe was removed leaves a blank band in Qualitative Results
The Results section's container was given margin-left: 3rem, so the section sits off-centre
defects.fix: Remove the margin-left so the container is centred like the others

defects.defect: A Vite client script tag left from saving the page from a dev server (it also 404s under the repository subpath)
defects.fix: Delete the script tag and audit the built page

defects.defect: A lab logo placed with position: absolute at the top left of the Method section, on top of the Method heading
defects.fix: Remove the logo or move it out of the heading's way (for example into the footer)

defects.defect: The opening <body> and skip link appear twice (a doubled template block), so two 'Skip to main content' links exist
defects.fix: Delete the second <body> line and the second skip link

content_must_stay: Quillwave: Sparse-Sensor Reconstruction of Synthetic Ripple Fields
